name: zoho-crm-widget-studio
description: Standalone Developer IDE for Zoho CRM Widgets

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
